topic: Exchanging Money for a Trip Back Home

script.title: MONEY FOR THE TRIP HOME
script.scene_zh: 銀行櫃台 · 預訂外幣現鈔
script.story_hook: His wallet is about to speak another language.
script.intro_zh: 他的錢包，即將換成另一種語言。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to today's bank scene. Listen for money exchange phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到今天的銀行場景。留意兌換外幣的實用說法。
script.outro: And that's travel cash, ordered smart. Listen again and try the number lines.
script.outro_zh: 旅行的現金就這樣聰明地訂好了。再聽一次，跟著說說談數字的句子。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.title_quote: Airports are where rates go to hide
script.char_a_description: a shy East Asian college student in his early twenties with buzzed black hair and bleached bangs, round wire glasses, an olive puffer jacket, a small crossbody bag, and a slight build
script.char_b_description: a cheerful woman in her sixties with a white pixie cut, gold cat-eye glasses, a teal silk blouse, a long pearl necklace, reading glasses on a chain, and a soft round build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, do you exchange money for international travel?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ du ju ɪkˈstʃeɪndʒ ˈmʌni fɚ ˌɪnɾɚˈnæʃənəl ˈtɹævəl/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，請問你們兌換出國旅行的外幣現金嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We do! Where are you flying to?
dialogue.phonetic: /wi du wɛɹ ɑɹ ju ˈflaɪɪŋ tu/
dialogue.zh: 可以啊！你要飛去哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Taipei, um, next week. Visiting my family.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌtaɪˈpeɪ ʌm nɛkst wik ˈvɪzɪtɪŋ maɪ ˈfæməli/
dialogue.zh: 台北，嗯，下個禮拜。回家看家人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wonderful. You'll want New Taiwan dollars, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwʌndɚfəl jul wɑnt nu taɪˈwɑn ˈdɑlərz raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。那你需要新臺幣，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, but honestly, I have no idea how this works.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs bʌt ˈɑnəstli aɪ hæv noʊ aɪˈdiə haʊ ðɪs wɝks/
dialogue.zh: 對，但老實說，我完全不懂這流程。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Easy: we order the cash, you pick it up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈizɪ wi ˈɔɾɚ ðə kæʃ ju pɪk ɪt ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 很簡單：我們先訂現金，你再來取。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Order? You don't keep it in the drawer?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔɾɚ ju doʊnt kip ɪt ɪn ðə dɹɔɚ/
dialogue.zh: 訂？你們櫃子抽屜裡不直接放現鈔嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This branch keeps a tiny stock, sorry to say.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs bræntʃ kips ə ˈtaɪni stɑk ˈsɑɹi tə seɪ/
dialogue.zh: 抱歉啊，這個分行只備一點點現鈔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I'd have to order it. How long is that?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪd əv tə ˈɔɾɚ ɪt haʊ lɔŋ ɪz ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 所以我得先下訂。那要等多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About three business days, sometimes just two.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt θri ˈbɪznəs deɪz ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz dʒʌst tu/
dialogue.zh: 大約三個工作天，有時候只要兩天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, my flight's Thursday... that's cutting close.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ maɪ flaɪts ˈθɝzdeɪ ðæts ˈkʌɾɪŋ kloʊs/
dialogue.zh: 好，可我週四就要搭機了……時間有點緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then today is exactly the right day to order.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn təˈdeɪ ɪz ɪɡˈzæktli ðə raɪt deɪ tə ˈɔɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 那今天正好就是下單的好日子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect timing, I guess. What's the rate like?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt ˈtaɪmɪŋ aɪ ɡɛs wəts ðə ɹeɪt laɪk/
dialogue.zh: 算我運氣好吧。請問匯率大概多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check... thirty-one point six per dollar.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi tʃɛk ˈθɝɾi wʌn pɔɪnt sɪks pɚ ˈdɑləɹ/
dialogue.zh: 我查一下……一美元換三十一點六。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that good? My roommate only got twenty-eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ɡʊd maɪ ˈɹumˌmeɪt ˈoʊli ɡɑt ˈtwɛnti eɪt/
dialogue.zh: 這算好嗎？我室友上次只換到二十八。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, twenty-eight sounds like an airport booth.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ˈtwɛnti eɪt ˈsaʊndz laɪk ən ˈɛɹˌpɔɹt buθ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，二十八這種數，一聽就是機場兌換櫃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That bad, huh? He looked so proud too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt bæd hʌ hi lʊkt soʊ pɹaʊd tu/
dialogue.zh: 那麼糟嗎？他當時還很得意耶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, airports are where rates go to hide.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈɛɹˌpɔɹts ɑɹ wɛɹ ɹeɪts ɡoʊ tə haɪd/
dialogue.zh: 哈，機場就是匯率躲起來的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the branch rate beats the airport?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə bræntʃ reɪt bits ði ˈɛɹˌpɔɹt/
dialogue.zh: 所以銀行的匯率比機場好？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually, plus a flat fee here, not a percent.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjuʒəwəli plʌz ə flæt fim hɪɹ nɑt ə pɚˈsɛnt/
dialogue.zh: 通常是。我們收固定手續費，不收百分比。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A flat fee? How flat are we talking?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə flæt fim haʊ flæt ɑɹ wi ˈtɔkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 固定手續費？到底是固定多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine ninety-five, no matter how much you order.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ˈnɪnti faɪv noʊ ˈmæɾɚ haʊ mʌtʃ ju ˈɔɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 九塊九毛五，不管你訂多少。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I'll order more than pocket money, sure.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪl ˈɔɾɚ mɔɹ ðən ˈpɑkət ˈmʌni ʃʊɹ/
dialogue.zh: 那我就要多訂一點，不只是零用錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How much do you think you'll need?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ du ju θɪŋk jul nid/
dialogue.zh: 你大概會需要多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe nine hundred dollars' worth? For a week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi naɪn ˈhʌndɪd ˈdɑlərz wɝθ fɚ ə wik/
dialogue.zh: 大概換九百美元？要去一個星期。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's reasonable for family trips, gifts and food.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈɹizənəbl fɚ ˈfæməli trɪps ɡɪfts ænd fud/
dialogue.zh: 回家探親這樣算合理，送禮、請客吃飯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gifts! I forgot about gifts completely, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪfts aɪ fɚˈɡɑt əˈbaʊt ɡɪfts kəmˈpliːtli hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 禮物！我完全把這回事忘了，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone does. Do you want small bills?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvɹiˌwʌn dʌz du ju wɑnt smɑl bɪlz/
dialogue.zh: 大家都會忘。你要小額的鈔票嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Small bills? Why would that matter?
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑl bɪlz waɪ wʊd ðæt ˈmæɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 小額鈔票？這有什麼差別？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Night markets hate big notes, trust me on this.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪt ˈmɑɹkəts heɪt bɪɡ noʊts tɹʌst mi ɑn ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 夜市最討厭大面額，信我這句。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, that's so true. Yes, lots of small ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðæts soʊ tru jɛs lɑts əv smɑl wʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 噢，說得太對了。好，多給我一些小鈔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll request fifties and hundreds, mixed evenly.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl ɹɪˈkwɛst ˈfɪɾiz ænd ˈhʌndɪdz mɪkst ˈivənli/
dialogue.zh: 我會請他們五十、一百混著配。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sounds ideal. Um, coins — should I worry?
dialogue.phonetic: /saʊndz aɪˈdiəl ʌm kɔɪnz ʃʊd aɪ ˈwɝɹi/
dialogue.zh: 聽起來很完美。呃，硬幣呢——這個要緊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Banks don't send coins, but you'll barely need them.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæŋks doʊnt sɛnd kɔɪnz bʌt jul ˈbɛɹli nid ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 銀行不附硬幣，不過你大概也用不到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, my pockets can't handle extra change.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd maɪ ˈpɑkəts kænt ˈhændəl ˈɛkstɹə tʃeɪndʒ/
dialogue.zh: 正好，我的口袋也塞不下更多零錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine neither. Now, do you have your ID?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn niðɚ nau du ju hæv jɔɹ aɪˈdi/
dialogue.zh: 我也是。好，你有帶身分證嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Driver's license, right here. Is that all?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdɹaɪvɚz ˈlaɪsəns ɹaɪt hɪɹ ɪz ðæt ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 駕照就在這裡。這樣就夠了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plus a quick order form, two lines, done.
dialogue.phonetic: /plʌz ə kwɪk ˈɔɾɚ fɔɹm tu laɪnz dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 再加一張只有兩行的訂單，就好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fine. And I pay when I pick it up?
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn ænd aɪ peɪ wɛn aɪ pɪk ɪt ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 好。錢是我來取的時候再付嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Actually, we debit your account today, at today's rate.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæktʃuəli wi ˈdɛbət jɔɹ əˈkaʊnt təˈdeɪ æt təˈdeɪz ɹeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 其實今天就會從你的帳戶扣，照今天的匯率。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So if rates move, that's locked already?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ɪf ɹeɪts muv ðæts lɑkt ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 所以就算匯率變了，也已經鎖定了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly locked, and also if rates drop. Fair?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli lɑkt ænd ˈɔlsoʊ ɪf ɹeɪts drɑp fɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 鎖定沒錯，匯率跌了也一樣。公平嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair enough. I'd rather sleep than gamble.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ ɪˈnʌf aɪd ˈɹæðɚ slip ðən ˈɡæmbəl/
dialogue.zh: 很公平。我寧可好好睡覺，也不要賭匯率。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same. What if plans change and you don't fly?
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm wət ɪf plænz tʃeɪndʒ ænd ju doʊnt flai/
dialogue.zh: 我也一樣。那如果計畫變了，你不飛了呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I'm holding weird foreign cash forever?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪm ˈhoʊldɪŋ wɪɹd ˈfɔɹən kæʃ fɚˈɛvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 那我就永遠拿著一疊奇怪的外幣紙鈔？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring it back within a year, we rebuy it.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɹɪŋ ɪt bæk wɪˈðɪn ə jɪɹ wi riˈbaɪ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 一年之內拿回來，我們會回購。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rebuy? So the money isn't trapped. Nice.
dialogue.phonetic: /riˈbaɪ soʊ ðə ˈmʌni ˈɪzənt tɹæpt naɪs/
dialogue.zh: 回購？所以錢不會卡死在保險庫裡。真好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small fee again on rebuy, but yes, not trapped.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑl fim əˈɡɛn ɑn riˈbaɪ bʌt jɛs nɑt tɹæpt/
dialogue.zh: 回購也會再收一點手續費，但錢確實不會卡死。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Again nine ninety-five, or does that change?
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈɡɛn naɪn ˈnɪnti faɪv ɔɹ dʌz ðæt tʃeɪndʒ/
dialogue.zh: 又是九塊九毛五？這個不會變嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, you were listening. That's the perk of asking.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ju wɚ ˈlɪsənɪŋ ðæts ðə pɝk əv ˈæskɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，你有在聽嘛。這就是多問一句的好處。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, when exactly can I pick it up?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wɛn ɪɡˈzæktli kən aɪ pɪk ɪt ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 所以，我到底幾時能來取？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thursday after ten, they ship to our vault overnight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɝzdeɪ ˈæftɚ tɛn ðeɪ ʃɪp tə aʊɹ vɑlt ˈoʊvɚˌnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 週四早上十點後，現鈔會隔夜送到我們金庫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thursday after ten... my flight's at six!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɝzdeɪ ˈæftɚ tɛn maɪ flaɪts æt sɪks/
dialogue.zh: 週四早上十點……可我六點就要起飛了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no, that's the wrong kind of perfect timing.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ ðæts ðə ɹɔŋ kaɪnd əv ˈpɝfɪkt ˈtaɪmɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 噢不，那就剛好卡在最糟的時間點上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any chance the airport branch could have it ready?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni tʃæns ði ˈɛɹˌpɔɹt bræntʃ kəd hæv ɪt ɹiˈdi/
dialogue.zh: 機場分行有沒有可能提前備好？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They can, but their fees are, well, airport-y.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ kæn bʌt ðɛɹ ˈfimz ɑɹ wɛl ˈɛɹˌpɔɹti/
dialogue.zh: 他們可以，不過他們的費用嘛，嗯，很機場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The hide-and-seek rate booth. Ugh, fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə haɪd ænd sik ɹeɪt buθ ʌɡ faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 就是那個愛躲匯率的兌換櫃。噢，好吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Or I'll rush this order to Wednesday, forty express fee.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔɹ aɪl ɹʌʃ ðɪs ˈɔɾɚ tə ˈwɛnzdeɪ ˈfɔɹti ɪkˈspɹɛs fim/
dialogue.zh: 或者我把這張單加急到週三，收四十美元快速費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wednesday is worth forty dollars, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɛnzdeɪ ɪz wɝθ ˈfɔɹti ˈdɑlərz ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，週三絕對值這四十塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done. Receipt's emailed, and safe travels to Taipei.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ɹɪˈsits ɪˈmeɪld ænd seɪf ˈtɹævəlz tə ˌtaɪˈpeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 搞定。收據會寄電子郵件給你，祝台北之行平安。

script.youtube_title_en: "Airports Are Where Rates Go to Hide" — Exchanging Money for a Trip Home
script.youtube_description:
要飛回家看家人，手頭卻沒有家鄉的現金，該去哪裡換？這一集 60 句沉浸式英語聽力，帶你走進美國銀行櫃台，從預約外幣現鈔一路聽到加急取貨。

你會聽到：問銀行能不能兌換外幣；匯率、固定手續費與百分比費用的差別；為什麼夜市討厭大面額、要請銀行混配小鈔；取貨日期跟班機時間撞上時，怎麼請行員加急；還有換回美元的回購問句。

整段對話都是 A2 初級單字與十個詞以內的短句，充滿真實語感：um、well、huh、ugh。聽完你就會用：What's the rate like、no matter how much、pick it up、safe travels。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，大聲跟著唸，把談錢的英文唸成直覺。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成母語。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱並打開小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
You're flying home to see family, but your wallet speaks the wrong currency. This 60-line immersive listening practice takes you to a US bank counter to order foreign cash — from the exchange rate all the way to a rush pickup.

You will hear: asking if the bank orders foreign money, the difference between a flat fee and a percent, why night markets hate big notes, what to do when the pickup day crashes into your flight, and how rebuying works if plans change.

Everything stays in A2-level words, ten per line at most, with real fillers: um, well, huh, ugh. By the end you'll own lines like What's the rate like, no matter how much, and safe travels.

The second half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let money talk become instinct.

No memorizing needed — listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe and ring the bell for a new scene every day.

📌 影片簡介：
下週就要飛回家，口袋裡卻一張家鄉的鈔票都沒有，銀行到底能不能幫你？為什麼同一塊錢，在機場換就特別虧？取貨日剛好撞上起飛日，怎麼辦？

這一集帶大家走進美國銀行的外幣櫃台，從匯率問起、固定手續費、小鈔混配，一路聽到加急送庫與回購規則，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
💵 匯率句：Let me check... thirty-one point six per dollar.
😂 吐槽機場：Ha, airports are where rates go to hide.
🏦 鎖定匯率：So if rates move, that's locked already?
⏰ 加急取貨：Or I'll rush this order to Wednesday, forty express fee.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、huh 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著這趟換幣準備旅程走一遍，下次你要飛回家之前，話自己就會冒出來。

祝你回家的路，一路順風。
